Q1: Which branch should the fix for the four failing heal-intake test assertions target?
Choices:
A. Target PR #7065's head branch `ai/issue-7059`. The fix PR stacks on it and edits only `tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py`, changing the four negative `issues_created` assertions to `not state_after.get("issues_created")` and the `comments_posted` read to `.get("comments_posted", [])`. The intake guard in `scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh` stays unchanged. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Make no separate fix PR. Close this issue as superseded and let PR #7065's own review/autofix loop fix the test assertions (the failed check-runs are already given to its editor through `CHECK_RUNS_AUTOFIX_ENABLED`).
C. Target the default branch `main` as the issue currently implies. **Note:** this is not workable on its own. The four failing tests are not on `main`, so the change would have nothing to edit there.
